summary: In src/sensei_top/cli.py's cmd_report, I added '(no deck)' as the final argument to each of the four COALESCE calls that build the deck label: the winrate section (COALESCE(deck_name, substr(deck_id,1,8))), and the play/draw, game-length, and per-turn-curve sections (COALESCE(d.name, substr(v.deck_id,1,8))). Rows for unpicked MTGO matches now label '(no deck)' instead of NULL, so slicing/formatting no longer raises and the report runs to completion. Nothing else in the function changed; print formats untouched. Both check commands pass: uv run pytest -q tests/test_cli_report.py (2 passed) and uv run ruff check . (All checks passed).
